Axmed brand kit. One system for web pages and social posts.

Everything here is live: the colours are read from brand/system.css, and the components are the same classes the website and the slides use. Change a token there and this page follows.

Start here

Both surfaces load the same token file. The website adds its layout layer on top; social slides use the slide classes inside it.

A web page

  1. Link system.css, then site.css.
  2. Wrap content in .wrap; headlines use .h2 with a quieter <span>.
  3. Build from the components below, never new colours or fonts.
  4. Run the lint and check 1440 and 390 wide.
<link rel="stylesheet" href="system.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="site.css">

A social post

  1. Link brand/system.css.
  2. Start from a .slide (1080 × 1350) or .slide.sq (1080 × 1080); add .field, .warm for the background.
  3. Place children absolutely: .head, .lead, .big, .ui, .brand.
  4. Render with node scripts/render-carousel.mjs.
<div class="slide field">
  <div class="big">4.2M</div>
</div>

Logo

Use the lockup by default. Clear space is at least half the mark's width on every side; the minimum height is 24 px. Never recolour, stretch or add effects.

Colour. One anchor, one accent.

Indigo leads, cyan is the single accent, and paper carries most of the space. Roughly 60% paper, 30% indigo, 10% cyan at most. No gradients across hues; glows stay in one hue. Click a token name to copy it.

Motion

Enter and exit on --ease-out, move on screen with --ease-in-out, hover colour on plain ease. Never ease-in. Reduced motion keeps fades and drops movement. Press a row to see the timing.

TokenUse forEasingTry it
--dur-press Press feedback, scale(.97)--ease-out
--dur-ui Hover colour, small UI changes--ease-out
--dur-swap Crossfades, tab and content swaps--ease-out
--dur-scene Marketing scenes only: entrances, reveals--ease-out
--dur-swap Things moving on screen--ease-in-out

Social formats

Live .slide examples at a quarter of their size. Carousels are 1080 × 1350 (5–8 slides, cover and a closing slide); WhatsApp cards 1080 × 1080; video cut-downs 1920 × 1080 and 1080 × 1920 with captions burned in. Headlines stay under eight words. Start a carousel from .claude/skills/axmed-carousel/template.html and a photo post from brand/photo-system/templates.html; both follow these rules.

Rules

We do

  • Put the buyer first: midwives, procurement officers, programme leads, in their own words.
  • Show the product working: AI quoting, QA checks, live tracking.
  • Use numbers with a source, from strategy/fact-sheet.md or the 2025 impact report.
  • Show Africa modern, urban and rural, confident.
  • Keep one idea per post and five elements or fewer in view.

We never

  • Invent numbers, quotes, partners or prices. Write [NUMBER NEEDED] instead.
  • Use AI faces for named people or partners, or synthetic testimonials.
  • Show poverty imagery or Axmed as the hero.
  • Add eyebrows, tracked capitals, italic accent words or arrows glued to labels.
  • Blend hues in a gradient or put a card inside a card.

Before anything goes out

  1. Every colour, font and timing comes from system.css.
  2. Web: node .claude/skills/hallmark/scripts/sloplint.mjs site/system.css site/site.css site/index.html --genre modern-minimal shows 0 FAIL, and the page works at 1440 and 390 wide.
  3. Copy passes the stop-slop rules and the voice table in brand/brand-guidelines.md.
  4. Felix approves every public number and claim; QA checks product and impact statements; partners approve their own story.
